lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately 12-15 high-luminance circular clusters arranged in three distinct horizontal rows posterior to the branchial region and superior to the pectoral fin.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal spot rows to form a rectilinear grid-like lattice on the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three parallel horizontal ridges are visible on the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient transition from light-intensity peaks to shadowed troughs.
